glossary.definition: (A) "Public improvement" means any construction, reconstruction, improvement, enlargement, alteration, demolition, or repair of a building, highway, drainage system, water system, road, street, alley, sewer, ditch, sewage disposal plant, water works, and any other structure or work of any nature by a public authority.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Public authority" includes the state, and a county, township, municipal corporation, school district, or other political subdivision of the state, and any public agency, authority, board, commission, instrumentality, or special district of or in the state or a county, township, municipal corporation, school district, or other political subdivision of the state, and any officer or agent thereof.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Material supplier" includes any person by whom any materials are furnished in furtherance of a public improvement.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Laborer" includes any mechanic, worker, artisan, or other individual who performs labor or work in furtherance of any public improvement.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Subcontractor" includes any person who undertakes to construct, alter, erect, improve, repair, demolish, remove, dig, or drill any part of any public improvement under a contract with any person other than the public authority.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Principal contractor" includes any person who undertakes to construct, alter, erect, improve, repair, demolish, remove, dig, or drill any part of any public improvement under a contract with a public authority.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Materials" means all products and substances including, without limitation, any gasoline, lubricating oil, petroleum products, powder, dynamite, blasting supplies and other explosives, tools, equipment, or machinery furnished in furtherance of a public improvement.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Wages" has the same meaning as "prevailing wage" in division (E) of section 4115.03 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Notice of commencement" means the notice specified in section 1311.252 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1311.25 to 1311.32 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (J) "Notice of furnishing" means the notice specified in section 1311.261 of the Revised Code.
